# Approved character-card visual reference

Frozen snapshot of the user-approved 2026-10-30 local preview, before formal integration. Apache-2.0 project-authored HTML, CSS, script and existing public brand image. It is synthetic reference content, never product data or runtime code.

Only the card presentation and design panel are exercised by `scripts/card-library-visual-parity.py`; world behavior is tested against the real product separately. Change this snapshot only following a new explicit visual decision, not to make a comparison pass. Native iframe/crop build outputs are deliberately excluded.
